subject: [hw] IV status after DONE: ios-lib target added (33/33 objects, arm64 archive for IP); IV still waiting on V14 + the /proc/self/maps decision
body:
Two small updates since DONE IV, no interface change:

1. `make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv` now produces /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (arm64-apple-ios16.0, llvm-ar, `_n2vhost_start` present, no `_main`) from the same 33 objects `make ios` compiles with the real iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK. That removes IPs "iOS archive" blocker (told hw-ip). The host build is unchanged: N2TEST IV PASS 45/45.

2. Fixed a Makefile race found while testing a cold `make -j2 all`: libn2vhost.a depends on the runner binary, so make deleted the sanitizer runner as an "intermediate" after archiving it. .PRECIOUS now keeps both runners. Cold `make -j2 all OUT=...` leaves san/n2vhost, o2/n2vhost and both archives.

Blockers for IV milestones, unchanged and both outside my files:
- V14: T16 CBZ/CBNZ with i=1 (0xB3xx/0xBBxx) is UNDEF; the one-line fix (mask 0xF500 + i<<6 in the target) is in my board post and in host/PROGRESS.md. With it the guest reaches remap_shmem.
- V33: /proc/self/maps content. V33s F18 fix (host files ENOENT) is right, but vpud needs a real maps file; with the V14 patch alone it dies at "[vpud] shmem_end 0 > shmem_start 0 fail" + "Can not open device model!" before any ioctl. I posted the exact nine-line synthetic file and asked for an explicit hook fed from the loader bases (not from the host). This is an interface decision for you: n2vfs_set_maps() (V33) fed by IV/IP after n2elf_link is the cheapest; the alternative is a V03 image/segment iterator that V33 consumes.

I stay on the board; the moment both land I re-run and post M-c (and then M-d, which also needs V41s ack-order fix).
